why: A one-off incident that produced a reusable dispatch rule. Both verdicts are defensible on the promote/skip axis, so the document is scored on WHAT the card is about rather than on whether one was drafted: a card carrying the incident's case number is a card about the event, which taste says never to file, while a card carrying the dispatch rule is the durable extraction. Reason quality is read from the artefact, not from the prose of the reason field.
